case_1_backend_down.expected_behavior: TraCI controller flags FALLBACK_FIXED mode and defaults to safe 40s/3s/2s fixed timer without skipping all-red clearance
case_1_backend_down.detail: Connection error handled cleanly. Signal transitions respected 3s yellow and 2s all-red with zero crash or abrupt cut.

case_2_camera_missing.scenario: Camera Perception Feed Disconnected / Stale Telemetry (>4s)
case_2_camera_missing.expected_behavior: Vision bridge flags missing frame; controller switches to fixed plan and auto-resumes when camera feed recovers
case_2_camera_missing.detail: Vision bridge reported stale timestamp. Signal timings reverted to fixed plan, auto-resumed adaptive mode upon reconnection.

case_3_fake_emergency_rejected.expected_behavior: Requests lacking 112 ID or unregistered fleet IDs must be REJECTED with security audit reason
case_3_fake_emergency_rejected.rejection_1: Rejection: Private medical alert requires a verified 112 Reference ID or Hospital Name.
case_3_fake_emergency_rejected.rejection_2: Rejection: Official ambulance 'AMB-UNAUTHORIZED-404' not found in registered emergency vehicle registry.
case_3_fake_emergency_rejected.detail: Both unauthorized attempts blocked before any signal modification occurred. Logged to emergency_log as REJECTED.

case_4_dual_emergency_conflict.scenario: Dual Conflicting Emergency Vehicles (Ambulance South vs Fire Engine West at Junction C)
case_4_dual_emergency_conflict.arbitration_rule: Lowest ETA / Patient Priority with Mandatory Clearance
case_4_dual_emergency_conflict.detail: Served AMB-108 first on Phase 0, executed 3s Yellow + 2s All-Red clearance, then served FIRE-101 on Phase 3, followed by 25s flush phase. Zero collision risk.
